title: Deliver Diamonds to Henley Market Bank
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Diamonds** delivered to **Henley Market Bank** (industry id 4, near tile 17,73).

A likely supplier is **Henley Market Diamond Mine** (industry id 5, near tile 29,88); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **290 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
